defects.what: On a phone (touch layout) on one of Andrii's scans, the crash toast of the automatic respawn is drawn over the recording bar (REC / Auto / Choose a folder) and the scene credit for the 2 s countdown
defects.evidence: evidence/2026-10-02/v03-release/phone-toast-over-rec-bar-390.webp (the live site, 390x844, Modlinek Villa, the test pilot's crash)
defects.why: the rec bar shows whenever the craft is not flying (cinema.css: hidden only under #ui.hud-flying) and the toast sits at the bottom on touch; accept-v03-respawn checks the toast against a list of boxes that has no .rec-bar (the bar came later, W3-5)
defects.fix: not fixed here (app code, needs a release): hide the bar or lift the toast while a crash toast is up on touch; add .rec-bar to the respawn bench overlap list
defects.screenshots: the landing's phone crash picture (m-crash) is taken with automatic respawn off (the crash panel), so it does not show this

defects.what: With the test pilot (?simradio=scenario) the OSD line says ACRO while the mode chip says ANGLE: the bot flies ACRO whatever the chip says
defects.fix: none needed for pilots; the screenshot of the chip is taken from a keyboard flight so it does not contradict itself

ownerToTry: Crash on purpose with the arm switch left ON: the toast counts down, 2 s later you fly again from 5 s earlier, still armed, no switch flip; the throttle should pick up from where your stick is (the benches held a simulated radio at hover)
Recalibrate (Controls): on the check screen flip your flight-mode switch: it must be found with no click; then flip it in flight: Angle / Horizon / Acro, and the chip says the radio decides
Without a mode switch: click the mode chip (top left) and press M; Angle must be the default on a fresh browser

Auto-record with the real Windows folder picker: recording bar -> Choose a folder, Auto on, arm / fly / disarm; next day after a reload it should ask once to allow the folder, then write there; open the file in DaVinci: 60 fps constant

Crashes off (Settings -> Crashes & respawn), land upside down and keep the throttle up: it should go a few seconds back by itself; tell us how the first second feels (a jump, a flip, a throttle punch)
Slow wall touches in a tight room (Modlinek Villa attic): under the crash threshold (4 m/s on the Pavo20) you should slide along the wall, not crash; with crashes off you bounce
N / Shift+N / F while armed with the radio: the radio must stay connected and the new scene start on its pad
A noisy scan with phantom walls: Settings -> Walls and voxel grid -> Drop floating pieces (16-64 blocks): do the invisible hits go away? V shows what is left
On your phone, one of your scans, crash with automatic respawn on: the toast covers the recording bar for 2 s (defect W45-1): is it in your way?

openChecks.what: accept-v03-prefs P10 fails on the live site: after Polish was picked, the language row reset (and a NEXT_LOCALE=ru cookie) leave the page in Polish
openChecks.why: the live simulator takes its language from the address (/pl/fly/), the dev server the check was written for from the cookie; picking a language works (en -> pl, cookie set), the reset only takes effect on the next address without a locale
openChecks.fix: not fixed here: the reset could navigate to the path of the browser language, or the check accept the path-locale behaviour

openChecks.what: tools/bench/src/accept-repo.ts fails on letters outside locales/ in 5 tracked files from earlier waves (apps/fly/src/ui/settings/model.ts, apps/fly/src/ui/superspl-tab-logic.ts, docs/wip/V03-WAVE1-STATUS.md, packages/prefs/test/catalogue-site.test.ts, tools/bench/test/app-settings.test.ts); README placeholders: none
